//:
Markup-fidelity fixture for the progress BAR component (pa-progress). See ../README.md and button.json/card.json for the model. Scope is the bare bar block:
. The pa-progress-group / pa-progress__label wrapper (composed label+bar) and pa-progress-ring are SEPARATE blocks, out of this slice — svelte folds the group into the same via labelText/valueText, keen splits it into a distinct progress_group/1 not wired into the dumper, so a shared bar-scoped golden can't cover it.

propsVocabulary.value: progress percentage 0-100 — sets inline style --value: N% on the fill, plus aria-valuenow on the bar
propsVocabulary.variant: colour variant (success|warning|danger|info) — primary is the BASE fill (var(--pc-primary-color)), emits NO modifier class
propsVocabulary.themeColor: 1..9 theme palette slot — pa-progress--color-N on the bar, paints the fill
propsVocabulary.animated: boolean — moving stripes (pa-progress--animated; brings its own stripes, no --striped needed)
propsVocabulary.phases: colour phases — a preset name (health = danger 0 / warning 40 / success 70; usage = success 0 / warning 60 / danger 85) or a list of { at, color }. color = role name (var(--pc-ROLE-color)), palette slot 1-9 (var(--pc-palette-N)), a custom variable '--name' (var(--name)) or any CSS colour as-is. Smooth/zoned modes emit pa-progress--phased + style --pa-progress-phases on the bar
propsVocabulary.phaseMode: smooth (default — stops 'C at%, …') | zoned (hard stops 'C at% next%, …', last runs to 100%) | value (no gradient: the whole fill takes the colour of the phase the value is in — success/warning/danger/info → pa-progress--ROLE, 1-9 → pa-progress--color-N, primary → nothing, anything else → style --pa-progress-fill on the bar)
propsVocabulary.steps: segmented bar — N blocks: pa-progress--segmented + style --pa-progress-steps: N on the bar
propsVocabulary.vertical: boolean — pa-progress--vertical (fill grows from the bottom)
propsVocabulary.length: CSS length of a vertical bar — style --pa-progress-length on the bar
propsVocabulary.indeterminate: boolean — pa-progress--indeterminate: unknown duration, NO aria-valuenow and NO --value on the fill

goldenConventions: Goldens encode the core snippet/demo shape (demo/views/data-visualization.mustache) PLUS the accessibility convention both wrappers carry on the SSR bar: role="progressbar" + aria-valuenow="{value}" + aria-valuemin="0" + aria-valuemax="100". The fill's percentage is a data-driven inline style (style="--value: {value}%") — treated as a scenario-provided value so both wrappers receive the same input; the width is static SSR markup, not the JS-animated fill (out of scope). primary is the DEFAULT variant and emits NO pa-progress--primary class (the base fill IS the accent colour; no such class exists in main.css). Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (grep '\.pa-progress(--|__)'). `produces: null` = structural/native (no pa-progress modifier). variant excludes 'primary' — the base fill is the accent, there is no pa-progress--primary in the CSS.

themeColor.note: theme palette slot on the fill (--pc-palette-N); svelte themeColor, keen theme_color

phases.note: smooth/zoned modes; the stops go to style --pa-progress-phases on the bar. Bar style vars are written in the order --pa-progress-phases, --pa-progress-steps, --pa-progress-length, --pa-progress-fill, joined with '; '

phaseMode.note: changes how phases render (see propsVocabulary); value mode produces existing variant/palette classes

value.note: structural — inline style --value: N% on the fill + aria-valuenow on the bar; no class

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

deferred.//: pa-progress__* element classes in main.css that belong to the COMPOSED label+bar shape (pa-progress-group / pa-progress__label row above the bar, _data-viz.scss), not the bare bar this slice scopes. Deferred to a future group slice — acknowledged out-of-scope (prose, not a fixture ref). A shared golden can't cover them today: svelte folds the label into <Progress> via labelText/valueText, keen splits it into a distinct progress_group/1 not wired into the dumper, so the two wrappers emit genuinely different label markup.
deferred.pa-progress__label: Label row above the bar (display:flex, justify-content:space-between) in the composed pa-progress-group shape — out of this bare-bar slice.
deferred.pa-progress__label-value: Right-hand value span inside pa-progress__label (the percentage/caption) — same composed-shape deferral.
